raw_segments.text: Astonished at their voices and their sight, nor were they dreams but visions of the night,
I saw I knew their faces and disgrayed in perfect view their hair with filace tied.
I started from my couch, a clammy sweat on all my limbs and shivering bodysate.
To heave and I lift my hands with pious haste and sacred incense in the flames I cast.
Thus to the gods their perfect honors done, more cheerful to my good old sire I run and
In little space he found his error of the double race, not as before he deemed
derived from Crete, no more deluded by the doubtful seat, then said,
O son, termled in Trojan fate, such things as these Cassandra did relate.
This day revives within my mind what she foretold of Troy renewed in Italy and
Laishan lands, but who could then have thought that Phrygian gods to Laishium should be brought,
or who believed what mad Cassandra taught? Now let us go where Phoebus leads the way.
